provenance.meaning: Actual anonymous production BEFORE evidence. It does not depict the new release.

method: Native network responses and original screenshot bytes. No route fulfillment, storage seeding, account creation, login, auth submission, email or member-data mutation. GET/HEAD/OPTIONS only; other methods were blocked before dispatch. Library cards scrolled into view before 24 thumbnail decodes; loaded fonts, background photos, focus, auth transitions, document and auth-panel containment checked.

attemptHistory.outcome: Environment interruption while writing the next 1440px Library PNG: ENOSPC. The browser was closed. It is retained as an interruption, not relabelled a successful first attempt.
Only the three remaining states captured after disk recovery while production was unchanged; then browser closed.

observations.finding: Decorative emblem paints over right-most fragments of the supporting copy. The form, consent and actions remain visible. This BEFORE issue is separately fixed and measured in the final staging phase. The initial smoke did not contain a Range/emblem intersection check.

limitations: Anonymous functional/media/focus smoke, not account sign-in or member mutation testing.
No new axe scan, manual assistive-technology, physical Safari, performance or blanket accessibility-conformance claim.
PNG dimensions are read from IHDR and all bytes verified against original capture hashes; this is not exercise-pose or licensing approval.
This phase alone does not establish production AFTER acceptance; see the later public-after receipt and matched comparison.
